hypothesis: Predicting positive excess-error magnitude and subtracting it continuously from expected gain will preserve profitable interventions better than a binary 0.5 hard veto while discouraging high-severity failures.

decision_rule.pilot_success: validation MAE below paired trend and not worse than frozen v1 Wiki, with lower harmful-intervention rate under the same diagnostic
decision_rule.pilot_failure: no MAE improvement over trend, worse MAE than frozen v1 without a material harm reduction, or any provenance failure
decision_rule.expansion: only after pilot success, freeze the exact configuration and run the remaining predeclared fold/seed combinations

locked_rules: Do not tune the unit downside weight or the existing gain threshold on outer validation results.
Do not change the parent Wiki, residual experts, folds, trend checkpoint or data cleaning in this pilot.
Do not use validation or test labels to fit the severity head or choose its decision rule.
Do not access the sealed test split or present this exploratory fold as final evidence.
